provenance.client: visible Chrome; four-player friendly room with three bots
provenance.method: 90-second bidirectional WebSocket application-message blackhole; no test-initiated close; endpoint closes forwarded
provenance.scope: normalized selected game fields and transport counters only; no authentication frames, identifiers or URLs
provenance.deliveryReconstruction: Playwright creates internal upstream WebSockets also seen by capture. The 97 normalized upstream game events during the blackout match the 97 dropped downstream frames. They are excluded from messages and retained separately as oracleMessages; this is reconstructed post-drop input, not a direct export from an installed extension.
provenance.limitation: not OS/TCP packet loss; game UI displayed connection-error refresh prompt despite event/state recovery
